subject.title: Telegram group chat history entries lose media data (only placeholder text preserved)

question: Should Telegram retain and replay media from unmentioned group messages, and if so under what visibility and retention boundary?
rationale: The code fix is technically bounded, but the product/security choice controls whether unmentioned group attachments may become available to a later agent turn and who is allowed to trigger that replay.

options.title: Approve bounded policy-limited retention
options.body: Record recent local image media in HistoryEntry.media for no-mention group history only within the existing history window, access policy, and short retention cleanup, then replay it to later mentioned turns.

options.title: Require explicit opt-in first
options.body: Add or require a group-level opt-in before retaining unmentioned group media, trading safer defaults for another configuration surface.

options.title: Do not replay unmentioned media
options.body: Keep text-only history for unmentioned media and document that users must mention the bot or reply directly when they want media inspected.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded policy-limited retention
recommendation.body: Record recent local image media in HistoryEntry.media for no-mention group history only within the existing history window, access policy, and short retention cleanup, then replay it to later mentioned turns.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest combined history across Telegram context, channel policy, and the security-sensitive plugin/core boundary involved in this decision.
